summary: Tested the Crew HQ / Crew Clubhouse split and the removal of crew tournaments. Backend: 9/10 pytest pass. The one failure is minor: GET /api/contests still lists a weekly crew contest under 'upcoming'. UI: harbour Crew HQ list works. It has no Wins/Weekly/contest/rank items and shows the level-30 create gate, Join/Request, the invites inbox (accept works), 'You sail with' and the go-crew-island button. Harbour crew detail shows only the public card (no tabs, no leave, no manage). Crew island: the clubhouse modal is titled 'Crew Clubhouse' and shows Home/Members tabs, plus Manage for the leader (invite-only toggle, invite angler, broadcast, emblem colour, join request approve). Leave works here. Crew chat tab works, and /game/tournaments works. Wiki 18 is titled 'Tournaments'. Problems found: join requests (Approve/Decline) still show in the harbour HQ; after leaving a crew on the island the player stays on that crew's island; some wiki text still mentions crew challenges.

minor.issue: 'upcoming' still returns [{kind:'weekly', category:'crew_species', label:'Crew Species', ...}] even though crew contests are retired (server.py ~2629-2630). current=[] works and open contests get cancelled. The frontend does not call /contests, so this is dead data. Return upcoming: [] or remove the endpoint.

Expired open contests still go through close_contest(), which pays out prizes, before the rest are cancelled. The comment says 'closed without prizes'. This only matters for leftover old docs; all are 'cancelled' in the preview DB now.

ui_bugs.issue: The harbour Crew HQ shows the leader/officer panel 'Join requests to your crew' with Approve/Decline buttons. That is a crew-management function, and the user asked for all crew functions to be on the crew island (Manage tab already shows the same requests). Fix: in the harbour, render <CrewInbox inbox={{invites: inbox?.invites||[], requests: []}} />.

After 'Leave crew' on the island the user stays in mode 'crew' on the ex-crew's island. The modal shows their old crew page with 'Request to join' and a Members tab (non-member can see the member list). Expected: dispatch fr-mode 'harbour' (or nav back) after leaving.

issues: wikiSections.js line 413 (Crews section) still says crews 'compete in a rotating weekly crew challenge ... pays gold ... Pearls'
wikiSections.js line 90 mentions 'crew contest', line 78 says crates come from 'crew challenges'
Guide pages RussianFishing4Alternatives.js:38 and CotwAnglerAlternatives.js:37 still mention 'weekly crew challenges'

design_issues.issue_note: Open crews that are full show nothing in the action column; the 'full' label only shows for invite-only crews (Crews.js line 242)

action_items: Hide join-requests (Approve/Decline) from the harbour Crew HQ; keep them only in Clubhouse > Manage
After leaving a crew while on the crew island, send the player back to the harbour (window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fr-mode',{detail:'harbour'})))
Remove the crew contest from GET /api/contests 'upcoming' (or drop the endpoint)
Update the wiki Crews section (line 413) and lines 78/90, plus the guide pages, to remove crew challenge/contest text
Optional: show 'full' for open crews at capacity
critical_code_review_comments: Crews.js reads fx.mode once per render (onIsland = fx.mode === 'crew'). It is not reactive state, so it only works because World re-navigates on mode change. Consider passing mode through context.

TABS in CrewTabs.js still includes contest/contract/hall/leviathan entries that are filtered out in two places (CrewTabs and Crews.js). This is dead config; remove them from TABS so the filter is not duplicated.
The Members tab has no 'member' requirement, so non-members on another crew's island page can see the member list.
